entries.feature: Sticky follow over CPU resorting: while on, every sample, sort or filter that moves the followed item ID to another row ends its plan, after every row operation, with that item's promotion (PX-011-G01), so the client selects and reveals it at its final place; a plan that does not move it promotes nothing; the followed row keeps its item ID and no row is created; the status names the PID, name and row

entries.feature: Manual pan: scrolling is local and never changes the selection or stops follow; the viewport stays where the user put it until the followed process changes row, and then the client scrolls the least distance that shows it

Non-follow mode never promotes on a sample or a selection: ordinary selection preservation is the client's, anchored to item IDs, and a resort moves neither the viewport nor the selection off its process

Stops honestly: when the followed process ends follow turns itself off and says so, and a new process that reuses its PID (a new item ID) is never followed, selected or revealed, in the same sample or later; a filter or the row limit that hides it stops follow with that reason; a selection that names no shown row stops it too; follow never moves to another row by itself
